mechanism: Losartan may reduce the antihypertensive efficacy of norethindrone-containing oral contraceptives through competitive antagonism at angiotensin II receptors, while norethindrone may increase losartan metabolism via CYP3A4 induction.
action: Monitor blood pressure control in patients using this combination; consider alternative antihypertensive agents if blood pressure becomes difficult to manage, and counsel on backup contraception if efficacy concerns arise.
